title: Supplement to 'Linear versus global stability in a Coulomb-penalized Matsubara spin chain': certificates, scripts and selective Lean proofs
description: Software supplement for SuperMatics-Inc/mustar-finite-window. Exact spin-stability identities, twenty fixed-index and sixteen fixed-frequency sufficient cells, an unrestricted flipped-spin counterexample and selective Lean proofs. No physical first-order superconducting transition is claimed. README.md states the hypotheses, trust bases and formalization limits. Manuscript sources and PDFs are excluded.
